question:
Find the sum of the mean and median of the given data.

12, 10, 16, 18, 20, 26, 14, 28
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Given data is : 12, 10, 16, 18, 20, 26, 14, 28

Number of observations = 8 

Mean = {sum x over n}

Mean = (12 + 10 + 16 + 18 + 20 + 26 + 14 + 28) / 8

Mean = 144 / 8

Mean
